name: Map Control Mobile
philosophy: Establish map control through strategic positioning: control neutral trees, chokepoints, and bullet deposits while maintaining mobile army.
key_changes: In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), moderate tree planting (0.3) balanced with unit production
In runArchon(), implement strategic positioning: move toward map center or neutral tree clusters
In runSoldier() and runScout(), implement patrol routes between important map locations
Add Scout units specifically for bullet collection from neutral trees and early map vision
In BulletSpending.spendPolicy(), maintain 40% of bullets as reserve for strategic flexibility
engagement_style: Map control gameplay; scouts gather intel and bullets, soldiers hold positions, army pushes from secured positions
